    Counting cocycles #

    For a finite family of relations ρ_r ∈ e_{t r} kD e_{s r}, the extension blocks crossA z ρ_r live in one block X(s r) → Y(t r) (crossA_eq_block). Hence the cocycles {z | crossA z ρ_r = 0 ∀ r} have codimension at most Σ_r dim X(s r) · dim Y(t r) in the space of extension data (finrank_data_le).

              Module.finrank k ↥cobL.ker + ∑ α : D.A, Module.finrank k ↑(X.obj (D.src α)) * Module.finrank k ↑(Y.obj (D.tgt α)) ≤ ∑ i : D.V, Module.finrank k ↑(X.obj i) * Module.finrank k ↑(Y.obj i) + ∑ r : Fin F.m, Module.finrank k ↑(X.obj (F.s r)) * Module.finrank k ↑(Y.obj (F.t r))

              Hom bounded by the bilinear form when all extensions split. If every cocycle is a coboundary, then dim Hom(X, Y) + Σ_α x_{s α} y_{t α} ≤ Σ_i x_i y_i + Σ_r x_{s r} y_{t r}, where Hom(X, Y) is the kernel of the coboundary map.
